name: Shardingbase Node
author: shardingbase@invalid.example
description: Runs the self-extracting Shardingbase node and its supervised Paper-compatible backend. Allocate enough container memory for BACKEND_MEMORY plus NODE_MEMORY and native overhead.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/backups
cd /mnt/server
if [ -n "${SHARDINGBASE_DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading Shardingbase Node from the configured URL"
    curl --fail --location --output "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SHARDINGBASE_DOWNLOAD_URL}"
else
    echo "No download URL configured. Upload Shardingbase-Node.jar as ${SERVER_JARFILE} after installation."
fi

variables.name: Node Heap (MiB)
variables.description: Heap reserved for the lightweight parent process. 128 MiB is normally sufficient.

variables.name: Backend Heap (MiB)
variables.description: Maximum heap assigned to the Minecraft child JVM. Container memory must also cover the node and native overhead.

variables.name: Extracted Backend Jar
variables.description: Plain filename used when the node exports its embedded backend beside itself.

variables.name: Minecraft Arguments
variables.description: Arguments forwarded unchanged to the backend server.

variables.name: Controller URI
variables.description: Pinned TLS control listener on Velocity, for example tls://proxy.example.net:8443.

variables.name: TLS Certificate SHA-256
variables.description: The 64-hex-character certificate fingerprint printed by the Velocity plugin.

variables.name: Node ID
variables.description: Must be node-a or node-b and match Velocity's node-credentials entry.

variables.name: Node Credential
variables.description: Secret generated in the Velocity plugin configuration for this node.

variables.name: Transfer Staging Root
variables.description: Directory used for resumable, hash-verified incoming world files.

variables.name: Backup Root
variables.description: Directory reserved for mandatory transaction backups.

variables.name: Backup Retention
variables.description: Number of completed transaction backups retained by node policy.

variables.name: Optional Node Download URL
variables.description: Optional direct URL used only during reinstall. Leave blank when uploading the jar manually.
